title: Dotnet developer
description:
Role: Senior. NET engineer
Location : RemoteJob Overview
1.8-12+ years of experience developing software & systems for medium to large business environments
Strong experience in one or more programming languages, technologies and software platforms, such as C#, Java Script, MS-SQL Server, Sybase, Angular/REACT.
2. At least 5+ year’s hands-on experience with one of the programming languages (e.g. C# using. NET Core)
3. Excellent problem solving and communication skills
4. Familiarity with multi-threading
5. Strong experience with good design principles (design patterns, cohesion/coupling, S. O. L. I. D.)
6. Experience with Services Oriented Architecture and RESTful services development
7. Hands on experience with microservices
8. Experience with writing clean and maintainable code using engineering best practices (unit testing using x Unit/n Unit, TDD, continuous integration and deployment (teamcity/octopus), automation, refactoring, version controlling etc.)
9. Strong experience working with other developers, quality engineers (QE), ops engineers and support engineers to ensure smooth deployment, continual operation and passion for developing good software.
10. Experience participating in design discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
11. Experience mentoring and coaching more-junior developers
12. Experience documenting business solution in technical documents and diagrams
13. Familiarity or experience with Agile engineering practices.
14. Hands on experience in Containerization of application. (Docker/Rancher/ Kubernetes).
15. Hands on experience in AI Tools (like Git Hub Copilot).”

title: World-class p-1, o-1, eb-1a visa petition writers
description:
World-Class P-1, O-1, EB-1 A Visa Petition Writers – Cricket & Tech
Work with the immigration team behind cricket legends. Now hiring writers for our tech expansion.
You know the names:Shahid Afridi. Suresh Raina. Irfan Pathan. Misbah-ul-Haq. Sreesanth. Mohammad Hafeez. Robin Uthappa.We helped them compete in the United States. Now we're using the same proven tactics to help AI/ML founders, researchers, and engineers obtain O-1 and EB-1 A visas.
About Us
We are a US-based immigration law firm with 500+ visa approvals and a 94% success rate. Our clients include world-class athletes, elite entertainers, and now – extraordinary tech talent. We've built proprietary AI tools and world-class templates that make petition writing faster and more effective than traditional firms.
tools powered by xtraordinaryresearch.com
The Role
We're hiring full-time Petition Writers to draft P-1, O-1, and EB-1 A visa petitions for:
Professional athletes (cricket, boxing, MMA, football)
AI/ML engineers, researchers, and founders
Tech executives with extraordinary ability credentials
What You'll Do
Draft persuasive support letters using our proven templates
Map client achievements to USCIS criteria (awards, publications, critical roles, high salary, etc.)
Organize exhibits using our internal PDF tools
Conduct supplemental research using AI-powered tools
Work directly with US-licensed attorneys on case strategy
What We're Looking For
US immigration petition writing experience (REQUIRED – ex-Deel, Plymouth Street, Boundless, or US law firm experience preferred)
Exceptional English writing skills
Ability to translate technical achievements (ML papers, patents, Git Hub contributions) into compelling legal narratives
Self-directed, detail-oriented, fast learner
What We Offer
Full-time remote position
Competitive salary + performance incentives
Flexible hours
Work on high-profile cases (athletes you watch, tech founders building the future)
AI-powered tools that do the heavy lifting – you focus on the writing
Growth opportunity as we scale our tech immigration practice

title: Direct response video editor for 8-figure dtc brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance BonusesWe're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1 M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, You Tube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.What You'll Actually DoHigh-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month):Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.Master Direct Response Mechanics:
Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, You Tube Shorts)
A/B test visual approaches based on performance dataPost-Production ExcellenceColor grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Da Vinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.Rapid Iteration & TestingPartner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.AI-Enhanced WorkflowLeverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.Top Fits Will Have:
Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
2+ years editing for DTC/e Commerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or Da Vinci Resolve + After Effects
Deep understanding of Meta/You Tube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)Bonus Points:
Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4 D)
Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools
Portuguese + English fluencyNon-Negotiables:
Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
Obsessive attention to detail
Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedbackWhy Top Editors Choose Us:Transparent CompensationBase salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.Career Growth PathStart as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.See Your Impact DailyDirect access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).️Professional SetupAccess to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.Fully Remote + FlexibleWork from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.High-Volume LearningProduce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.Application Process:Step 1: Submit Application
Current CV/resume
Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted)
Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it workedStep 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD)Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.Step 4: OnboardingStart with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.

title: Direct response video editor for 8-figure dtc brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance BonusesWe're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1 M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, You Tube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.What You'll Actually DoHigh-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month):Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.Master Direct Response Mechanics:
Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, You Tube Shorts)
A/B test visual approaches based on performance dataPost-Production ExcellenceColor grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Da Vinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.Rapid Iteration & TestingPartner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.AI-Enhanced WorkflowLeverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.Top Fits Will Have:
Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
2+ years editing for DTC/e Commerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or Da Vinci Resolve + After Effects
Deep understanding of Meta/You Tube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)Bonus Points:
Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4 D)
Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools
Portuguese + English fluencyNon-Negotiables:
Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
Obsessive attention to detail
Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedbackWhy Top Editors Choose Us:Transparent CompensationBase salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.Career Growth PathStart as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.See Your Impact DailyDirect access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).️Professional SetupAccess to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.Fully Remote + FlexibleWork from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.High-Volume LearningProduce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.Application Process:Step 1: Submit Application
Current CV/resume
Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted)
Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it workedStep 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD)Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.Step 4: OnboardingStart with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.

title: Ps systems engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U. S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.Key Responsibilities
Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.Skills & Experience
3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.

title: Gcp data engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forGCP Data Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Proficiency in Big Query, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub
Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and Postgre SQL
Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)
Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization
GCP certifications
Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP
Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)
Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures
Understanding of Data Lake layers
Knowledge of batch and streaming processing
Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and No SQL)
Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as Big Query, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.
Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.
Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.
Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.
Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.
Implement best practices for Data Ops and Data Governance.Big Query, Dataflow, Alloy DB, APIGee (focus in GCP)What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#Buildingonbelief

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Sr. technical customer success analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst
Business Unit: Graphic Communications
Location: Brazil, RemoteGraphic Communications( a CAI Division)is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries.Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy thatGraphic Communicationssucceeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at aSr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to theSr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.
In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.Key Responsibilities
Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities
Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify Java Script or API failures.
Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or c URL.
Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.

Apoiar a gestão dos contratos e custos da Diretoria Operacional com foco na eficiência operacional e financeira, segurança e qualidade nos Aeroportos Vinci do Brasil, promovendo governança e uniformidade organizacional.

Visão e Missão

Nosso propósito é: CONECTAR PARA TRANSFORMAR. Conectar VISÕES para transformar REALIDADES. Na VINCI Airports no Brasil, conectar é mais do que transportar – é criar elos que impulsionam mudanças positivas no mundo. Não apenas administramos aeroportos, criamos experiências que ampliam horizontes, oferecemos soluções que geram progresso e construímos um setor aeroportuário mais sustentável e inovador.

Formação e Requisitos

Graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

  • Familiaridade com compliance contratual, SLAs e gestão de riscos;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Power BI, Excel avançados.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Finanças, Gestão de Contratos ou áreas afins (desejável).
  • Formação em Auditoria ISO 9001. Experiência com auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a contratos e custos.
Responsabilidades
  • Mapear, organizar e monitorar todos os contratos operacionais, incluindo vigência, valores, SLAs e conformidade legal;
  • Preparar, atualizar e acompanhar o cronograma anual de RFPs (Request for Proposals) da diretoria;
  • Implementar métodos de medição e controle de contratos, incluindo indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios periódicos;
  • Participar de auditorias internas nos contratos, identificando não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Apoiar e participar de projetos para a implementação de melhorias e ações de eficiência nos contratos operacionais;
  • Apoiar a gerência promovendo reuniões periódicas para acompanhamento e alinhamento dos contratos operacionais;
  • Organizar e manter atualizado o arquivo digital e físico dos contratos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a conformidade documental;
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão dos orçamentos anuais das gerências operacionais (CAPEX e OPEX);
  • Apoiar a realização de análises financeiras de OPEX e CAPEX;
  • Apoiar no monitoramento da execução dos OPEX e CAPEX;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs financeiros da diretoria;
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais e análises comparativas de custos para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da Diretoria Operacional;
  • Analisar dados financeiros e contratuais, transformando-os em informações estratégicas para a tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar tendências e padrões nos dados, propondo melhorias para a gestão de custos e contratos.
Localização

América do Sul, Brasil, Bahia. Cidade: São Cristóvão, Salvador - State of Bahia, Brazil.

Sobre a VINCI Airports

A VINCI Airports, como a maior operadora privada de aeroportos no mundo, gerencia o desenvolvimento e as operações de 46 aeroportos localizados na França, em Portugal, no Reino Unido, na Suécia, Sérvia, no Camboja, no Japão, nos Estados Unidos, na República Dominicana, na Costa Rica, no Chile e no Brasil. Atendida por cerca de 250 companhias aéreas, a rede VINCI Airports transportou 240 milhões de passageiros em 2018. Por meio de sua expertise como um integrador abrangente, a VINCI Airports desenvolve, financia, constrói e opera aeroportos, aproveitando sua capacidade de investimento, network internacional e know-how para otimizar a gestão e o desempenho das infraestruturas aeroportuárias existentes, suas extensões e projetos de novas construções. Operar máquinas de circulação extracorpórea, em cirurgias torácicas, cardíacas, de transplante de órgãos, de revascularização periférica e terapias de oxigenação por membrana extracorpórea (ECMO), a fim de garantir a manutenção das atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes, durante a realização das cirurgias. Assegurar o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos e a manutenção da função cardiovascular dos pacientes, durante os procedimentos, permitindo que os cirurgiões realizem as intervenções necessárias, com segurança.

Main responsibilities
  • Participar da implantação de projetos de perfusão;

  • Realizar montagem de materiais descartáveis nos equipamentos de perfusão;

  • Utilizar técnicas assépticas, para lidar adequadamente com o manuseio de materiais estéreis e biológicos;
  • Zelar pelo estado funcional (guarda, segurança e devolução) dos equipamentos da empresa;
  • Registrar informações dos procedimentos cirúrgicos realizados, em aplicativos/sistemas corporativos, para que as equipes de Assistência de Vendas e Faturamento, possam dar seguimento às etapas internas;

  • Preencher relatórios de controle e outros necessários, conforme solicitação da Gestão.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely;
    able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.

Data and Reporting

    proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks

Contracts

  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team

title: Strategic Executive Assistant To The Ceo
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a "thinking partner" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's "20% focus" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules;
we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who "just gets it" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility;
    this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero "emotional leakage".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities;
    proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the "breakfast of champions" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  1. Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  2. Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  3. Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  4. Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  5. Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled "Lastname.Firstname.EA.Pdf") to (operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  1. Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  2. Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

description:
Canopy Life Sciences is a well-respected vendor & partner in the life sciences industry, assisting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients in various functional areas of expertise. Our culture is one of empowerment. Everyone has a voice and plays a role in the success of the business and a role in developing our values & behaviors. We recruit, train, and develop people to ensure the very best for our client partners.

Medical Science Liaison – Dermatology - Brazil

This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Trial Support

Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.

Engage with clinical trial sites and investigators to ensure smooth trial operations and alignment with study objectives.

Provide education and training to clinical sites on study protocols and therapeutic areas.

Insight Generation and Framework Creation

Gather and synthesize insights from healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and other stakeholders to identify referral patterns, challenges, and opportunities for trial enrollment.

Develop frameworks to streamline patient identification and referral pathways.

Stakeholder Engagement

Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.

Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.

Cross-Border Collaboration

Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.

Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.

Travel Requirements

Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.

Independent Work

Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.

Qualifications and Experience

A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.

Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.

Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.

Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.

Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.

Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.

Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.

Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (e.G., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.

Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.

Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.

description:
Somos uma instituição que tem a tradição e inovação como pilares. A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, que sempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana, tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Nosso único meio para recebimento de currículos é através da plataforma Gupy, assim como todas as etapas do processo admissional, ambas situações acessadas com login e senha cadastrados pelo próprio usuário, enquanto cliente da plataforma.*

title: Assistente de operações
description:
Assistente de Operações

O Assistente de Operações é responsável por apoiar a execução das atividades operacionais em campo e garantir que os processos, rotinas e ações do projeto aconteçam com fluidez, qualidade e alinhamento às metas estabelecidas. É um cargo que atua como ponte entre a coordenação do projeto, as comunidades e as equipes internas, assegurando que as informações circulem de maneira ágil e que as entregas sejam realizadas no prazo. Para ter sucesso nesse cargo, a pessoa precisa ser dinâmica, organizada, comunicativa e manter uma postura proativa diante de desafios, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência e a consistência das operações.

No contexto da Bee2Be e da organização como um todo, esse cargo desempenha uma função estratégica ao garantir a execução das iniciativas na ponta, fortalecendo a relação com parceiros, promovendo padronização dos processos, assegurando a qualidade operacional e dando suporte contínuo para decisões baseadas em dados e evidências. O Assistente de Operações reforça a cultura de campo, aproxima a organização das comunidades atendidas e sustenta a base operacional necessária para escalar projetos com segurança e impacto.

Responsabilidades

O Assistente de Operações realiza visitas técnicas, acompanha atividades em campo, organiza dados operacionais, monitora metas e indicadores, apoia na implementação de planos de ação, articula com equipes e parceiros, registra informações de forma padronizada e contribui para a resolução rápida de problemas operacionais. Atua em alinhamentos internos, reuniões e ações de mobilização, garantindo que o projeto avance com ritmo, qualidade e consistência.

Qualificações

Para desempenhar esse papel, são desejáveis habilidades de organização, comunicação clara, relacionamento interpessoal, capacidade analítica e adaptabilidade. A pessoa precisa ter iniciativa, perfil mão na massa, habilidade para trabalhar com diferentes públicos e facilidade em lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas. Experiência prévia em operações, campo, projetos sociais ou produtivos, além de familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e coleta de dados, são diferenciais que fortalecem o desempenho no cargo.

Formação e Escolaridade

É necessário possuir ensino médio completo. Será considerado um diferencial ter formação técnica ou superior (completa ou em andamento) em áreas como Agropecuária, Agroecologia, Biologia, Zootecnia, Gestão Ambiental, Administração, Desenvolvimento Rural ou Gestão de Projetos. Essas formações contribuem para uma melhor compreensão das atividades em campo, e organização das rotinas operacionais, mas não são obrigatórias para a candidatura.

We believe in championing all perspectives, individuals and teams because we understand the importance of seeing the world and our business through many different lenses. Atuar no setup da máquina, visando liberação dela para a produção em série obedecendo os padrões de tempo;

  • Executar todos os procedimentos de segurança de acordo com a as normas de engenharia de segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Seguir cronograma de limpeza do equipamento, além de eventual solicitação por parte do setor de qualidade, uniformidade e produção;
  • Substituição de bladders e demais itens de responsabilidade do setup, de acordo com a avaliação no local, obedecendo solicitação dos departamentos de qualidade, uniformidade e construção/vulcanização;
  • Responsabilizar-se por relatar toda e qualquer ocorrência durante seu respectivo turno que envolva a segurança, qualidade do produto e/ou perda de produção;
  • Manter o estoque necessário de bladders montados e de reposição na área do setup;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva nos subconjuntos do setor, necessários para a realização do setup das máquinas, deixando-os em perfeitas condições de uso;
  • Interceder junto a manutenção quanto a solicitação de qualquer tipo de serviço necessário para reparo, recuperação, fabricação e manutenção dos equipamentos do setup;
  • Fazer reparo e/ou substituição de bladders e demais itens de responsabilidade do setup, de acordo com a avaliação no local, obedecendo solicitação dos departamentos de qualidade, uniformidade e construção/vulcanização.

Qualificações / Qualifications:

title: Analista de Dados Jr
description:
Sobre a oportunidade


Estamos buscando um Analista de Dados Júnior para fortalecer nossa área de Pessoas, com foco em criar inteligência estratégica para apoiar decisões sobre contratação, desempenho, engajamento e produtividade.

A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico com pensamento crítico — alguém capaz de transformar dados em ações práticas que impulsionem resultados humanos e organizacionais.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar, atualizar e manter dashboards interativos (KPIs, painéis dinâmicos, filtros avançados e visualizações inteligentes).
  • Estruturar, modelar e tratar bases de dados, utilizando Power Query, relacionamento entre tabelas e normalização.
  • Desenvolver indicadores preditivos voltados para risco de desligamento, performance, produtividade e eficiência operacional.
  • Analisar padrões de comportamento e apoiar tomadas de decisão estratégicas da área de Pessoas e Liderança.
  • Traduzir dados complexos em insights claros, recomendações práticas e relatórios acionáveis.
  • Atuar em colaboração com time de Expansão, Liderança Comercial e demais áreas internas para garantir maturidade analítica nas entregas.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em Power BI (modelagem, DAX, visualizações e boas práticas).
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (tratamento de dados, fórmulas, automatizações).
  • Capacidade analítica e visão crítica de negócio.
  • Organização, autonomia e atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Familiaridade com análises preditivas e indicadores de People Analytics.

O que oferecemos

  • Wellhub;
  • Opções de plano de saúde.
  • Parcerias com empresas do comércio (farmácias, instituições de ensino, saúde e bem-estar);

A SVN Investimentos foi fundada em 2006, em Maringá, por Felipe Bernardes e Caio Copetti, e hoje é reconhecida como o melhor escritório de investimentos do Sul do Brasil pela rede XP, com mais de 40 mil clientes ativos e com um volume assessorado que ultrapassa o valor de R$ 30 bilhões.

A empresa tem unidades em 11 cidades espalhadas por todo o Brasil, sendo elas: Aracaju, Campo Grande, Cascavel, Cuiabá, Curitiba, Foz do Iguaçu, Londrina, Maringá, São Paulo e Salvador. description:

  • Sempre que necessário, ajudar a carregar e descarregar os equipamentos nos veículos da loja e dos clientes;

title: Analista tributário
description:
ATRIBUIÇÕES

Responsável por apoiar a equipe da empresa na implementação efetiva das políticas e governança industrial e tributária;

Apoiar a gestão na melhoria do progresso das actividades de encerramento fiscal;

Fornecer insights para gerar KPIs internos e sua apresentação aos superiores.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

Pós-graduação em Gestão Tributária, Controladoria, Contabilidade Tributária ou áreas correlatas;

Inglês Avançado/Fluente;

Domínio em apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL;

Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias: EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DCTF, ECF, SPED Fiscal e Contábil;

Experiência com retenções na fonte (IRRF, INSS, PIS/COFINS/CSLL);

Experiência com os sistemas Mastersaf, TaxOne e SAP;

Pacote Office avançado (Excel e Power Bi);

Capacidade analítica avançada e visão crítica para identificar riscos e oportunidades tributárias, rigor técnico, atenção aos detalhes e forte senso de compliance;

Capacidade de analisar dados complexos e tomar decisões baseadas em evidências;

Perfil proativo, organizado, com habilidade para lidar com altas demandas e prazos curtos;

Boa comunicação para interação com auditorias, áreas internas e órgãos fiscais;

Atualização constante sobre legislação tributária e mudanças fiscais;

Ampla experiência trabalhando no domínio tributário, incluindo obrigações, compliance, gestão de riscos, operações, cálculos fiscais, projetos fiscais e resolver questões fiscais de forma eficiente;

Negociação e Resolução de Litígios.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

Assistência Médica e Odontológica, extensivo a dependentes;

Seguro de vida coletivo Porto Seguro, isento de mensalidade;

Transporte Fretado ou Auxílio Combustivél;

Refeitório no Local;

Vale Alimentação para te ajudar nas compras do mês;

Wellhub para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;

Programas de saúde e bem-estar para a melhoria da sua qualidade de vida;

Cartão Golden Farma para compras em farmácias cadastradas com desconto diretamente em folha, valendo tanto para medicamentos como para itens de higiene e beleza;

Auxílio creche, conforme regras de elegibilidade.

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO

Etapa 1: Cadastro

Etapa 2: TRIAGEM RH

Etapa 3: ENTREVISTA COM O RH

Etapa 4: ENTREVISTA COM O GESTOR

Etapa 5: Contratação

Sobre nós

A BYD (Build Your Dreams) é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que tem a missão de criar inovações tecnológicas para uma vida melhor. Fundada em 1995, contamos com mais de 30 parques industriais e estamos presentes em mais de 70 países, provendo excelência nas indústrias de eletrônicos, automóveis, energia limpa e transporte.

A BYD está comprometida com o desenvolvimento sustentável com seus valores de excelência, pragmatismo, paixão e inovação na promoção da geração de energia, armazenamento eficiente e mobilidade elétrica. Estamos presentes no Brasil desde 2015, com unidades em Campinas, São Paulo, Manaus e agora em Camaçari.

Nós nos dedicamos à fabricação de painéis solares, baterias e chassis de ônibus elétricos, e em breve a produção de automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na nossa fábrica em Camaçari, na Bahia. Comercializamos também automóveis, caminhões, furgões, máscaras descartáveis e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de termos um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo, onde forneceremos trens e sistemas para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô de São Paulo.

Se você, assim como a gente, é prático, objetivo, inovador, apaixonado pelo que faz e focado em excelência, venha se juntar ao nosso time e faça parte da construção de um futuro mais verde Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

title: Consultor(a) Técnico(a) de Pós Vendas
description:

  • Analisar com antecedência o histórico de passagens dos veículos agendados, usando o sistema corporativo (NBS), com intuito de auxiliar na confecção do orçamento, buscando informações como último serviço realizado e quilometragem, a fim de realizar uma venda construtiva garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

  • Assegurar a máxima qualidade no atendimento prestado ao cliente, através de acompanhamento do início até o final do processo, com a finalidade de manter o cliente muito satisfeito e garantir o serviço correto na 1ª vez.

Realizar o preenchimento da Folha de Inspeção do Veículo, através de uma vistoria no veículo junto ao cliente, buscando identificar possíveis avarias para serem revertidas em vendas, deixando o cliente ciente da situação em que o veículo se encontra.

Documentar todas as alterações realizadas na infraestrutura.

Analisar incidentes de segurança e atuar tecnicamente em sua resolução.

Administrar ferramentas de antivírus corporativo, EDR e monitoramento.

Analisar logs de aplicações, servidores web, bancos de dados e serviços integrados.

Solucionar problemas complexos que envolvam múltiplas plataformas.

Criar soluções para coleta de logs, geração de relatórios e redução de tarefas repetitivas.

Melhorar processos de monitoramento e operação.

Criar alertas, dashboards e relatórios de performance.

Atuar rapidamente frente a falhas ou desvios identificados.

Atualizar bases de conhecimento utilizadas pelas equipes N1 e N2.

Registrar padrões operacionais e planos de emergência.

Apoiar tecnicamente as equipes de níveis 1 e 2.

Conduzir treinamentos internos para padronização de processos e boas práticas.

Avaliar desempenho técnico e orientar melhorias.

Operar e validar planos de Disaster Recovery (DR).

Garantir alta disponibilidade e prevenção de falhas críticas.

Proatividade e autonomia na tomada de decisões.

title: Auxiliar de Atendimento Logístico
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura:


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Logística:


A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes.

Conheça um pouco mais do time de Logística no Nosso Manifesto.

Como é ser um(a) Auxiliar de Atendimento Logístico | GREEN ANGEL (Moto):


Conhecido como Green Angels, esse time tem a missão de realizar o atendimento do(a) nosso(a) cliente diretamente em seu ponto de venda.

A sua atividade principal é atender nossos(as) usuários(as) de maneira externa, tanto dentro da cidade como nas regiões de abrangência, ajudando-os na inicialização e utilização correta dos produtos que contratou conosco.

Além disso, você também será o responsável pelas atividades realizadas no polo onde irá atuar, realizando a gestão do estoque, recebimento de ativos, logística reversa, triagem dos equipamentos, organização e inventários periódicos do estoque.

Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Green Angel aqui.

O que esperamos de você:

  • CNH A ou AB (Moto) ativa por pelo menos 2 anos;
  • Ensino Médio completo.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Ter concluído ou estar cursando Técnico ou Ensino Superior em Logística, Administração, Engenharias e afins.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente.
  • Experiência com Logística.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.

title: AI & Robotics Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with experience building and deploying perception and sensor-based ML systems in robotics or autonomous platforms. The role involves working across the full lifecycle of data, models, and deployment—from raw sensor streams to production-ready perception modules.

This is a great fit for someone who has worked with LiDAR, cameras, radar, IMUs, or multimodal pipelines, and who enjoys taking ML systems from prototype to field-tested reality.

Key Responsibilities

Perception & Sensor Fusion

  • Develop ML pipelines for multimodal sensor data (LiDAR, cameras, radar, IMU, etc.).

  • Implement or support sensor fusion approaches (classical or ML-based).

  • Build models and processing steps for perception tasks such as detection, tracking, mapping, or scene understanding.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with robotics engineers, software teams, and simulation teams to ensure seamless integration of ML perception modules.

  • Contribute to design discussions involving sensing hardware, data capture strategies, and operational requirements.

Model Development & Deployment

  • Train, evaluate, and optimize ML models for robotics perception under real-world constraints.

  • Deploy ML components to diverse environments (edge devices, robotics stacks, cloud backends).

  • Collaborate on performance tuning, latency improvements, and reliability enhancements.

If you have

  • Experience working with robotics or autonomous systems.

  • Hands-on work with LiDAR, cameras, radar, or IMU pipelines.

  • Strong Python and ML fundamentals, with experience in at least one major framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Experience designing or maintaining sensor-based ML systems, including data preparation and evaluation.

  • Understanding of model deployment in real systems (edge devices, robotics stacks, embedded platforms, or cloud).

It's a plus

  • Experience with sensor fusion frameworks, classical or ML-based.

title: Ajudante De Copa
description:
Você conhece o Club Med?
Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto nível nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes estão em busca de felicidade e liberdade.

Por que está lendo este anúncio? Porque você quer fazer parte daquele pequeno extra que nos torna diferentes. Você tem as habilidades humanas e profissionais que estamos procurando.

Oferecemos a você a oportunidade de se desenvolver e crescer muito rapidamente, juntando-se às nossas equipes brilhantes. Você poderá viajar pelo mundo.

Seu ambiente de trabalho

Cada resort tem vários restaurantes e bares, tanto voltados para eventos quanto mais íntimos, que atendem à nossa oferta Premium All Inclusive. Esses espaços permitem que os hóspedes se reconectem uns com os outros e definam o ritmo de cada destaque do dia. Do bufê ao restaurante bistronômico, passando pelo bar temático ou pela adega de degustação, você se encontrará em um ambiente multifacetado. Nossa oferta refinada é construída em torno de 5 pilares: criar experiências memoráveis, surpreender com uma infinidade de áreas gastronômicas conceituais, trabalhar para o bem-estar de todos (inclusive o seu), brincar com as emoções e os sentidos por meio de encenações, tudo em um ambiente divertido e descontraído.

Você será

  • Sociável, você sabe como se conectar com nossos clientes e estabelecer um relacionamento baseado na confiança
  • Eficiente, você tem um senso de prioridades e limita o tempo de espera
  • Atencioso, você oferece um serviço personalizado a cada um de nossos clientes

Você deverá

  • Será responsável pela limpeza e desinfecção das cozinhas, do back office, dos bares e restaurantes, dos banheiros e das lixeiras
  • Manusear produtos TDC e detergentes para os departamentos de Alimentos e Bebidas e garantir que esses produtos sejam armazenados adequadamente
  • Participar do inventário e alertar seu gerente sobre as necessidades de TDC e detergente para garantir que o serviço funcione sem problemas
  • Encarregar-se da limpeza e da manutenção dos equipamentos nas salas de lixo do departamento de Alimentos e Bebidas
  • Remover, esvaziar e limpar as lixeiras de acordo com os padrões de saúde e segurança

Juntar-se às nossas equipes também é uma oportunidade única de viver e trabalhar com pessoas de todas as esferas da vida, em alguns dos locais mais Instagramáveis do mundo.

Você ganhará uma experiência valiosa para o seu currículo, trabalhando para uma empresa que o apoia e oferece treinamento contínuo para ajudá-lo a se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmo.

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas com deficiência.

Descrição de cargo

Buscamos um profissional Sênior de Finanças para transformar dados em decisões de negócios (5 hamburguerias, um restaurante italiano, um boteco e um bar de alta coquetelaria) garantindo previsibilidade e rentabilidade das unidades.   • Realizar análise crítica de CMV, CMC, despesas e margem de contribuição por unidade;
  • Controlar repasses e movimentações financeiras entre empresas do grupo (múltiplos CNPJs);

2. Fluxo de caixa e saúde financeira do Grupo

3.DRE e orçamento

  • Consolidar e entregar DRE mensal por unidade e consolidada;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar Orçado x Realizado por centro de custo e classificação de gastos;
  • Elaborar plano de ação junto aos gestores quando houver desvios.

4.Análises estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão

  • Estudos de viabilidade para expansão, novos projetos e investimentos;
  • Simulações de ROI, margem, payback e ponto de equilíbrio;
  • Preparar material de apresentação para reunião mensal com sócios.

Entregas

1. Entregas Diárias

  • Posição de caixa consolidada (saldo + projeções + agenda de pagamentos)

2. Entregas Semanais

  • Atualização de dashboards e relatório de acompanhamento de budget;
  • Check de desvios e follow-ups com gestores das unidades.

3. Entregas Mensais

  • Fechamento do mês (DRE gerencial + análise e plano de ação);
  • Relatório de performance consolidado do grupo e por unidade;
  • Controle de repasses entre empresas (CNPJs) e validação com sócios.

Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com fluxo de caixa, projeções financeiras, DRE gerencial e orçamento;
  • Excel/ Google Sheets avançado (Power Query / Power BI é diferencial);

  • Experiência com empresas multiunidade/multicentro de custo;

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à entrega - reponsável por transformar números em decisões.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em food service, varejo de alto volume ou franquias;
  • Ter atuado como controller/ FP&A/ Analista Financeiro Sênior.

Visão Geral da Empresa / Company Overview


Sobre nós

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), com sede em Nashville, Tennessee, e a Bridgestone Europa, Oriente Médio e África (BSEMEA), com sede em Bruxelas, Bélgica, operam coletivamente como uma região estratégica "Bridgestone West". Na Bridgestone, você é sempre Livre para Ser.
